falsification_condition: A request solved by a measuring agent whose atom identifiers were shuffled (that would mean the label, not the measurement, carried the knowledge), or a demonstration baseline that beats measurement on a large number of requests per machine (that would invert the cost law).

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. A coding benchmark floor cannot move while the reachable edit space is a hand-written list that omits whole classes of real fix; this makes the reachable space a measured property and one transfer real. No obligation is discharged, no benchmark gain is claimed, and no capability or independent credit is claimed.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Templates prune the space before execution: 224 candidates instead of 5,021 for the same held-out half.

obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: The list edit is a hard zero on real fixes; the budget cannot reach an inexpressible edit; the token rule has no position or context; a model is prohibited producer cognition.
